entries.description: The Raytheon Sentinel R1 is a Bombardier Global Express modified as an airborne battlefield and ground surveillance platform for the British Royal Air Force. Originally known as the ASTOR (Airborne STand-Off Radar) programme the aircraft is operated by a RAF squadron manned by both air force and army personnel. The first flight of the modified prototype was in August 2001, which validated the modifications required for the ASTOR system.
